tree_boundary: Uncommitted follow-up on the environment/SlotCache and textured-hit/RT-shadow slices. No isolated before/after whole-renderer claim; prior artifacts preserve their dated source boundaries
scope: Shared single-scattering sky-grid background and GPU publication, native serial headless thessa-perf adapter, coarse GPU command intervals, first-hit/back-lit shadow-query reduction
hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Vulkan on Linux; no other-backend runtime claim

contracts.source: Existing resolved atmosphere enable/quality/steps/density/multi-star/airglow and shared thessa-atmosphere sky_radiance; no second scattering model
contracts.quality: Existing Low/Medium/High 8x4/16x8/32x16 source grid and minimum refresh 8/4/2 frames. Consumer samples bilinearly with azimuth wrap/elevation clamp; no additional quality switch
contracts.publication: One scene-owned EnvironmentBinding updated per revision. Background and mesh/RT consumers share GPU buffer handles, not new CPU-grid clones or duplicate texture/buffer uploads. Replacement consumers rebind the current source even when revision is unchanged
contracts.draw: One fullscreen far-depth triangle after terrain in the existing render pass; LessEqual depth without writes. Later opaque meshes load/overwrite normally. No extra target/prepass/depth-copy/pass/submission, CPU scattering or per-frame grid upload
contracts.directions: Inverse projection at z=0.5, then rotation by the camera's body-fixed world_from_view with w=0; excludes translation and supports infinite-far projections
contracts.disabled: Absent/disabled field drops sky pipeline/bind, issues no background draw, preserves prior clear fallback exactly. Shared grid release leaves metadata plus a 16-byte binding placeholder only. Airless bodies have no synthetic atmosphere
contracts.render_limit: Single-scattering coarse grid and manual exposure into existing LDR target; not finite sun disks, aerial perspective, ground radiance, multiple scattering, HDR/tonemapping or automatic exposure
contracts.shadow_reduction: Opaque shadow rays skip back-lit sources whose direct diffuse/GGX contribution is zero and use RAY_FLAG_TERMINATE_ON_FIRST_HIT. Closest-hit reflection traversal is unchanged; no isolated speedup claim

isolated_background_cost.boundary: 1280x720, no visible terrain, fully uncovered sky fill; CPU encode/submit + GPU completion, not isolated GPU timestamps. Setup, CPU field production and readback excluded. Producer grid retained in both controls; consumer draws only when enabled

performance_adapter.schema: Existing thessa-perf PerfCapture JSON and sibling CSV, last 1800 measured frames after 30 warmup; capture is written after rendering
performance_adapter.capability: Only explicit capture negotiates stable TIMESTAMP_QUERY + TIMESTAMP_QUERY_INSIDE_ENCODERS. Unsupported features leave GPU unavailable but preserve CPU capture. Normal runs have no profiler collector, query buffers or readback
performance_adapter.gpu_boundary: Five marks bound consecutive command intervals; sum is the reported GPU command span. Includes barriers/scheduling, terrain classification and any dirty mesh AS builds. Excludes queue-write uploads before first mark and separate egui command buffers. Not isolated sky, AS, upload or per-ray costs, nor a complete end-to-end GPU frame
performance_adapter.cpu_boundary: frame.cpu is host wall time through submit, not processor cycles; frame wall includes GPU completion. Timestamp map/readback, RSS sampling and capture writing excluded from frame samples, but may perturb next-frame scheduling
performance_adapter.csv: Sorted union of gpu_scope:NAME_ms columns appended after existing CPU scope columns. Missing or unavailable GPU scope is blank, measured zero is 0.0000. JSON schema unchanged
performance_adapter.metadata: Actual adapter/backend/driver, requested/resolved graphics and scenario. Commit stays unknown unless the existing build metadata mechanism supplies it; artifact states source boundary explicitly
performance_adapter.limits: Serial offscreen diagnostics only; not asynchronous window/Bevy profiling, complete native simulation telemetry, full world-counter population, per-pass physics instrumentation or backend memory queries

pre_shadow_cache_native_gpu_profile.boundary: Sequential silent profiled release runs before exact atlas reuse, 349 resident tiles and 426240 drawn terrain triangles, static X15,1280x720,no HUD,3s prestream,30 warmup+120 measured. Median uses statistics.median; p95 uses sorted[int(n*.95)]. All three captures report hardware GPU timestamps. No concurrent build and no isolated throughput/cross-run speedup claim
pre_shadow_cache_native_gpu_profile.interpretation: The measured static atlas GPU interval motivated the subsequent exact-depth cache. Off and Local both retain specular reflections; shadow-only disables them and is not equal reflection work. Summing medians need not equal the median of sums. Final/native source and check results for exact reuse are recorded in native-shadow-depth-cache-2026-10-17.json

numeric_oracles.sky: Every pixel agrees with independent CPU ray unprojection + EnvironmentRadiance::sample within 2/255; three grid qualities, growth/shrink, camera rotation across seam/poles, large coordinates and infinite-far projection
numeric_oracles.foreground: Sky on leaves terrain foreground byte-identical; disabled background restores the complete baseline exactly
numeric_oracles.publication: Native hardware test verifies one scene GPU upload over unchanged frames and replacement terrain/mesh consumers; resolved disable before a replacement renderer drops the stale grid/sky
numeric_oracles.timing: Unit checks seconds conversion/invalid ordering; hardware test verifies actual nonnegative advancing timestamps and three reuses of one query/readback allocation; ordinary device exposes no profiler
numeric_oracles.capture: Native executable hardware test checks three measured frames, JSON/CSV shape and capability truth; CLI rejects window use, non-JSON output and a colliding screenshot path; CSV test distinguishes missing/unavailable/zero GPU scope values
numeric_oracles.not_proven: These tests bound transport/sampling, not a global atmosphere approximation envelope or blind aesthetic preference. Prior environment horizon/forward-lobe errors remain

reproduction.silent_environment: ALSA_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/target/render-batch/silent-alsa.conf PULSE_SERVER=unix:$PWD/target/render-batch/no-pulse-server PIPEWIRE_REMOTE=thessa-test-no-audio; null ALSA output, system audio settings unchanged
reproduction.scenario_configs: All native preview modes use version=1, preset=high, renderer.surface_quality=high and shadows.enabled=true. Off: specular_reflections=true, ray_tracing=off; Local: specular_reflections=true, ray_tracing=local; shadow-only: specular_reflections=false, ray_tracing=local. Remaining settings inherit the standard schema/preset
